correctness.rationale: TARGET route: verified Lemmas 1-4 directly. Lemma1 non-archimedean ultrametric induction |a_k|=|c|^{d^{k-1}} and archimedean escape with lambda=R^{d-1}-1>1 give integrality and |sigma(c)|<=2, hence h(c)<=log2. Lemma2 height comparison |h(f(x))-d h(x)|<=h(c)+log2 is standard and spot-checked on 1000 random rationals plus artifact script. Lemma3 telescoping gives |hat-h|<=C/(d-1) and preperiodic => hat=0 => h(x)<=2log2 uniformly in d,c,K. Lemma4 Mahler bound M<=4^D and |b_j|<=binom*M<=8^D yields count D^2*(2*8^D+1)^{D+1}. Values B(1)=289, B(2)=8586756 and D=1 enumeration 23 reproduced. No gap in boundary cases.

originality.rationale: Literal headline B(D)=D^2*(2*8^D+1)^{D+1} unconditional degree-independent bound for PCF x^d+c was searched in literal, synonymous, and dominance forms via one fused scope_literature_search with full provider coverage. Nearest leads (Doyle-Hindes 2408.14657, Benedetto-Ih 2010.15941, Rajagopal-Zhang 2510.26119) were escalated to full-text theorem-scope inspection and all are NOT_COVERING: prior degree-independent bounds are conditional on abc/abcd or function-field-only, exact explicit bounds depend on d (d^D) or require extra reduction hypotheses, and PCF-height finiteness work does not state any preperiodic-count bound. No source states or implies the explicit unconditional D-only closed form.

value.rationale: TARGET claim advances recognized Morton-Silverman uniform-boundedness question on natural PCF unicritical subfamily with motivation predating computation. Unconditional degree-independence over all d>=2 and all K of degree D was previously available only conditionally (Looper, Doyle-Hindes abc) or in d-dependent form (d^D); an explicit computable D-only bound B(D) was not known or mechanically implied as a closed form. Future workers need such exact uniform finiteness benchmarks. Huge size is disclosed as non-sharp limitation, not a value defect under the shared standard for exact invariants of natural objects.
